items.question: What website do UAE higher education students use to register for the National Practical Training Platform?
items.gold: Students register through Nafis at nafis.gov.ae.
items.fact: National Practical Training Platform accessed via nafis.gov.ae website

items.question: Can government and private-sector companies in the UAE post available training opportunities on the National Practical Training Platform for higher education students?
items.gold: Yes, government and private-sector institutions and companies can post available training opportunities.
items.fact: Government and private companies may post training opportunities on platform
